models.name: thermal_comfort_pmv_ppd
models.title: Thermal comfort: Fanger PMV-PPD model
models.summary: Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) and Predicted Percentage of Dissatisfied (PPD) after Fanger (1970): full body heat balance (breathing, perspiration, sweat, clothing, radiation, convection) with the activity and clothing selected from two embedded lookup tables.
models.authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: boiler_mean_specific_heat
models.title: Fuel-oil boiler modelled with the mean specific heat of the flue gases (cpbar)
models.summary: Fuel-oil heating boiler represented as a combustor (adiabatic flame temperature from the mean specific heat of the combustion products, routine cpbar of the ULiege combustion library) followed by a gas-to-water eps-NTU exchanger and an envelope-loss term; computes the boiler efficiency.
models.tags: boiler;combustion;fuel oil;mean specific heat;flue gas;eps-NTU;adiabatic flame temperature;on/off control;exercise
models.authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, CoolSolve example); Jean Lebrun (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model); Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model)

models.name: scroll_compressor_semi_empirical
models.title: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor in a refrigeration cycle
models.summary: Reference model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002) as implemented by V. Lemort: six-step compression path (supply drop, heating-up, isentropic compression to the adapted pressure, isochoric compression, exhaust cooling, exhaust drop) with internal leakage, fictitious-wall heat transfers and electromechanical losses; parameters identified on a Copeland ZR72KC-TFD catalogue, refrigerant cycle reduced to an evaporator and a condenser at imposed saturation temperatures. A simplified variant without leakage (converted from the EES original in bar/kJ units) is included.
models.tags: scroll compressor;semi-empirical;reference model;parameter identification;refrigeration;part load;internal leakage;built-in volume ratio
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)

models.name: two_stage_steam_compressor_intercooling
models.title: Two-stage compression of superheated steam with intercooling at the optimal intermediate pressure
models.summary: Superheated steam (0.15 kg/s, 100 kPa to 625 kPa, 100 K superheat) is compressed by a two-stage isentropic compressor with intercooling back to the supply temperature, the intermediate pressure being set by the rule of equal stage pressure ratios (the work-minimising choice for ideal gases, Cengel & Boles). The model compares the powers of the single-stage isentropic, two-stage and isothermal (INTEGRAL of v dP) compressors and of a liquid pump, and computes the heats rejected in the intercooler and by the isothermal compression.
models.authors: N. Paulus; B. Dechesne; S. Quoilin (course MECA0002)

models.name: dry_air_screw_compressor_leakage
models.title: Dry air screw compressor with internal leakage
models.summary: Dry (oil-free) screw air compressor between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 3 bar discharge: three parameters identified at the 7000 rpm nominal point (swept volume, mechanical-loss torque, equivalent leakage-throat area) are imposed, and the model predicts the performance at another speed (2000 rpm default) with the leakage flow through a choked equivalent nozzle mixed back into the suction, isentropic internal compression and mechanical losses dissipated to the surroundings.
models.tags: screw compressor;dry air;internal leakage;volumetric efficiency;isentropic efficiency;exercise
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: piston_compressor_identification
models.title: Piston compressor - parameter identification from two operating points
models.summary: Piston air compressor between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 3-10 bar discharge: four parameters (swept volume, clearance factor, constant electromechanical losses, loss factor) identified from two measured operating points (square system) are imposed at their rounded values, and the model predicts the flow rate and power at two new operating points (10 bar at 3000 rpm, 7 bar at 2500 rpm).
models.tags: piston compressor;reciprocating compressor;parameter identification;volumetric efficiency;clearance volume;exercise
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution); Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: refrigeration_compressor_identification
models.title: Refrigeration compressor - parameter identification from two operating points
models.summary: R22 reciprocating refrigeration compressor in a vapour-compression cycle (3 K subcooling, 5 K superheat): four parameters (swept volume flow rate, clearance factor, constant electromechanical losses, loss factor) identified from two measured operating points (cooling capacity and power at two condensing/evaporating temperature pairs, square system) are imposed at their rounded values, and the model predicts the cooling capacity and power at a third operating point (40 C condensing, 2 C evaporating).
models.tags: reciprocating compressor;piston compressor;refrigeration compressor;parameter identification;volumetric efficiency;clearance volume;exercise
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution); Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: centrifugal_turbocompressor_performance
models.title: Centrifugal turbocompressor performance (air)
models.summary: Air flow rate drawn by a centrifugal turbocompressor (impeller + vaneless diffuser) at constant isentropic efficiencies: velocity triangles at the impeller outlet, Euler equation, diffuser pressure recovery; solves the nominal point and can be swept towards the maximum pressure ratio.
models.authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, course Machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition of 2004-10-12, exercise 2; author not identified)

models.name: counterflow_hx_oil_water
models.title: Counterflow heat exchanger - oil cooled by water (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Counterflow heat exchanger cooling an oil of constant specific heat with water, rated with the effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, counterflow effectiveness, outlet temperatures and transferred power.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: condenser_three_zones
models.title: Air-cooled condenser, three-zone parametric model
models.summary: Semi-empirical three-zone model (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) of an air-cooled R134a condenser with epsilon-NTU laws and flow-rate-fitted conductances; ships the combined crossflow/counterflow configuration plus purely counterflow and purely crossflow variants.
models.source_path: ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/modeles/Condenser_3_zones/Condenser three zones parametric model model (combined crossflow-counterflow) - CC080108-1.EES
models.authors: Cristian Cuevas (Universidad de Concepción)

models.name: hx_constant_pinch
models.title: Heat exchanger with an imposed pinch (three zones)
models.summary: Condenser sized by an imposed pinch and subcooling: three refrigerant zones (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) against a single-phase coolant, with the saturation pressure closed by the pinch condition. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexCstPinch condenser branch.
models.authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Titouan Janod

models.name: crossflow_hx_hot_gas_water
models.title: Crossflow heat exchanger - hot gas heating water (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Crossflow heat exchanger using hot gas of constant specific heat to heat pressurised water, rated with the crossflow effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, effectiveness, transferred power, gas flow rate and required exchange area.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: shell_and_tube_steam_condenser
models.title: 1-2 shell-and-tube steam condenser (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: 1-2 shell-and-tube condenser of a steam power plant (30 000 water-cooled tubes, steam at 50 C) rated as a semi-isothermal exchanger with the effectiveness-NTU method: water temperature rise, Colburn-analogy water-side coefficient, overall coefficient and tube length.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: dhw_tank_dynamic
models.title: Domestic hot-water storage tank: dynamic temperature evolution
models.summary: Transient energy balance of a fully mixed 500 L domestic hot-water tank over a 5-hour scenario (10 kW heater for 1 h, cooldown, 2 h tap draw with 12 C make-up water, ambient losses), integrated with INTEGRAL and a 1-s step.
models.tags: domestic hot water;storage tank;thermal storage;dynamic;time integration;exercise
models.authors: N. Paulus (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory); B. Dechesne (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory)

models.name: single_cylinder_engine_weibe
models.title: Single-cylinder engine with Weibe combustion (crank-angle dynamic)
models.summary: Crank-angle-resolved model of one cylinder of a four-stroke spark-ignition engine: the cylinder pressure, gas mass, combustion heat release (Weibe function in a PROCEDURE), wall heat losses and piston work are integrated with INTEGRAL over the intake stroke (-360 to -180 deg), with a choked intake flow through the intake valve and the charge modelled as a single ideal gas with constant gamma.
models.tags: internal combustion engine;four-stroke;spark ignition;Weibe combustion;crank angle;time integration;ideal gas;choked flow;exercise;reference model
models.authors: TBD (ULiège engine thermodynamics course exercise, 2008-2009; author not identified in the source); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: gas_engine_full_power_cpbar
models.title: Full-power operating point of a 4-stroke gas engine (combustion products with cpbar)
models.summary: Steady-state energy and mass balances of a 4-stroke gas engine at its nominal operating point: throttle, isentropic compression, combustion in which the products are described by their mean specific heat cpbar (routine of the ULiege combustion library, copied from CSL-0005), isentropic expansion and cooling by the water jacket.
models.tags: internal combustion engine;four-stroke;gas engine;natural gas;mean specific heat;combustion products;eps-NTU;cooling water;exercise;throttle
models.authors: ULiege MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example internal_combustion_engine_cpbar)

models.name: two_shaft_gas_turbine_compressor_map
models.title: Two-shaft gas turbine with a compressor map and two expanders
models.summary: Steady-state model of a two-shaft gas turbine (single-spool compressor and combustor, two mechanically independent expanders) on air: the compressor is described by a performance map (reduced flow, pressure ratio and isentropic efficiency versus reduced speed), the combustor by an energy balance with the mean specific heats of the ULiege combustion library, and expander 1 by a power balance from which its isentropic efficiency is found. Revision exercise of the ULiege course 'Machines et systemes thermiques', in three parts.
models.tags: gas turbine;two-shaft;compressor map;lookup table;turbine map;combustion chamber;mean specific heat;reduced properties;ideal gas;exercise
models.authors: Jean Lebrun (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: orc_simple_r245fa
models.title: Simple ORC with imposed component performance (R245fa)
models.summary: Subcritical R245fa Organic Rankine Cycle for quick performance screening (Quoilin thesis Ch. 5.3): oil-heated evaporator, water-cooled condenser, recuperator, expander and pump with imposed effectivenesses and pinch constraints; computes pressures, state points, net power (14.8 kW) and cycle efficiency (15.7 %).
models.tags: organic Rankine cycle;waste heat recovery;screening;recuperator;imposed effectiveness;pinch
models.authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: orc_extraction_r134a
models.title: ORC with two-stage expander and intermediate extraction (R134a)
models.summary: R134a Organic Rankine Cycle (T_ev = 90 °C, T_cd = 30 °C) whose screw/scroll-type expander is described stage by stage: isentropic first expansion, extraction of 13 % of the flow at an intermediate pressure, isentropic second expansion and constant-volume discharge; the extracted vapour is mixed with the exhaust and cools the pumped liquid in an internal heat exchanger. Determines the pressures, all state points, a 4.99 kW expander power, 35.6 kW boiler duty and a cycle efficiency of 11.7 %.
models.authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory) — probable, to be confirmed by the maintainer

models.name: refrigeration_cycle_simple_compressor
models.title: Refrigeration cycle with a simple compressor model
models.summary: Vapour-compression refrigeration cycle driven by a reciprocating compressor described by a clearance-volume volumetric efficiency and a linear loss model; compares R22, R134a and propane.
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: heat_pump_basic_tespy
models.title: Basic heat pump (TESPy tutorial)
models.summary: Single-stage R134a vapour-compression heat pump after the TESPy basic tutorial: evaporator and condenser with 2 % pressure drop each, constant-efficiency compressor, isenthalpic valve; delivers a prescribed condenser heat output with a COP parametric study.
models.authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors

models.name: refrigeration_cycle_basic_r134a
models.title: Basic vapour-compression refrigeration cycle (R134a)
models.summary: R134a refrigeration machine between -10 °C (evaporator) and 20 °C (condenser) with 6 K subcooling, 2 K superheat and a compressor of 0.75 isentropic efficiency driven by a 0.80-efficiency motor; computes the refrigerant flow rate, compressor power and COP for 50 kW of cooling.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: heat_pump_cycle_r22_30kw
models.title: R22 heat pump cycle delivering 30 kW
models.summary: R22 heat pump between 8 °C (evaporator) and 60 °C (condenser) with 10 K subcooling, no superheat and a compressor of 0.80 isentropic efficiency, fed by 10 °C groundwater (evaporator effectiveness 1); computes the COP, the refrigerant flow rate and the groundwater flow rate for 30 kW of heating.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: rankine_cycle_60mw
models.title: Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam power plant
models.summary: Simple Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 °C, 0.2 bar condenser): steam flow rate, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, cycle efficiency, back-work ratio; state points as arrays for the diagrams.
models.authors: TBD

models.name: rankine_cycle_regenerative_extraction
models.title: Steam Rankine cycle with regenerative extraction
models.summary: 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 C, 0.1 bar condenser) with a regenerative steam extraction at 25 bar to an open feedwater heater: steam and extraction flow rates, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, plant thermal efficiency; state points as arrays for the diagrams.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: cpbar_combustion_products
models.title: cpbar: mean specific heat of CmHn combustion products (function library)
models.summary: Three EES routines of the ULiege combustion library (cpbar, gamma, mmprod) returning the mean specific heat, the specific-heat ratio and the molar mass of the combustion products of a CmHn fuel in simplified air, between two temperatures, for complete combustion, incomplete combustion (with unburned-CO losses) or pure air.
models.tags: combustion;mean specific heat;flue gas;fuel-air ratio;excess air;incomplete combustion;unburned CO losses;function library
models.authors: P. Ngendakumana (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory)

models.name: methane_tank_evaporation
models.title: Evaporation of liquid methane in a tank
models.summary: Liquid methane at 500 kPa in a tank evaporates due to heat input (level drop of 30 mm per hour); the model computes the evaporated mass and the volumetric flow rate of the gas leaving a heater at 500 kPa and 275 K.
models.authors: TBD

models.name: pipe_pressure_drop_colebrook
models.title: Pipe pressure drop with the Colebrook-White friction factor
models.summary: Friction pressure drop of n-pentane in a straight pipe (16 mm diameter, 10 m): Darcy friction factor from the implicit Colebrook-White equation checked against an explicit approximation, linear and total pressure drop, dynamic pressure.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: chilled_water_cooling_coil
models.title: Chilled-water air cooling coil, dry and wet regimes
models.summary: Chilled-water air cooling coil (series air/wall/water resistances): dry regime by counterflow epsilon-NTU, condensation-risk check, wet regime by wet-bulb effectiveness with contact-factor outlet state and condensate flow.
models.authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: air_handling_unit_moist_air
models.title: Air handling unit with moist-air conditioning
models.summary: Room supplied with outdoor air through an air handling unit: supply state from the room sensible and moisture loads, cooling coil by contact effectiveness with post-heating; computes coil capacity, post-heating power and condensate flow.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: two_speed_cooling_tower
models.title: Two-speed cooling tower (regimes and mean fan power vs water set-point)
models.summary: Evaporative cooling tower with a two-speed fan, each regime rated with the epsilon-NTU method on a fictitious dry fluid following the wet-bulb temperatures of the moist air; returns the outlet temperatures, heat rejected and weighted-mean fan powers for a given water outlet set-point.
models.authors: ULiège MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: moist_air_cooling_coil_contact_factor
models.title: Moist-air cooling coil with contact factor
models.summary: Moist air cooled over a coil of given mean surface temperature: contact factor applied to temperatures and humidity ratios, total/sensible/latent heat per kg of dry air and condensate mass.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)
